title: Nightwing: Leaping into the Light
creators: Tom Taylor, Bruno Redondo, Adriano Lucas
description: Dick Grayson steps up to defend Blüdhaven with a newfound inheritance from Alfred Pennyworth and a new canine companion named Haley (Bitewing).

title: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow
creators: Tom King, Bilquis Evely, Matheus Lopes
description: Kara Zor-El joins an alien girl on an interstellar quest for vengeance, traveling across strange galaxies in this breathtaking epic fantasy space western.

title: Static: Season One
collectedIssues: Milestone Returns: Infinite Edition #0, Static: Season One #1–6
creators: Vita Ayala, Reginald Hudlin, Nikolas Draper-Ivey, Denys Cowan
description: At Virgil Hawkins' first protest, tear gas mixed with an experimental compound gave dozens of people powers. Now Static must balance high school and protecting his city.

title: DCeased
creators: Tom Taylor, Trevor Hairsine, Stefano Gaudiano
description: A corrupted Anti-Life Equation spreads through digital screens turning billions into ravenous, rabid techno-zombies, threatening Earth and the Justice League.

title: Far Sector
creators: N.K. Jemisin, Jamal Campbell
description: Hugo Award-winning author N.K. Jemisin and Jamal Campbell introduce Sojourner 'Jo' Mullein, a rookie Green Lantern assigned to investigate the first murder in 500 years in the City Enduring.

title: Mister Miracle
creators: Tom King, Mitch Gerads
description: Scott Free is the greatest escape artist in the universe, but can he escape suicide, domestic exhaustion, and an ongoing cosmic war against Apokolips? Darkseid Is.

title: Dark Nights: Metal
creators: Scott Snyder, Greg Capullo, Jonathan Glapion
description: The Dark Multiverse invades the prime DC Universe, unleashing the Batman Who Laughs and nightmare Batmen forged from Bruce Wayne's deepest fears.

title: Batman: White Knight
creators: Sean Gordon Murphy, Matt Hollingsworth
description: In an alternate Gotham, Joker is cured of his insanity and assumes the identity of Jack Napier, waging a legal campaign against Batman's unchecked vigilante devastation.

title: Wonder Woman: Earth One
creators: Grant Morrison, Yanick Paquette, Nathan Fairbairn
description: A radical rethinking of Diana of Themyscira's origin and golden age utopian mythology by Grant Morrison and Yanick Paquette.

title: Batgirl of Burnside
creators: Brenden Fletcher, Cameron Stewart, Babs Tarr
description: Barbara Gordon relocates to Burnside, Gotham's trendiest neighborhood, building a fresh DIY costume, social media life, and crime-fighting crew.

title: Injustice: Gods Among Us: Year One
creators: Tom Taylor, Jheremy Raapack, Mike S. Miller
description: After the Joker tricks Superman into destroying Metropolis and Lois Lane, Superman establishes a ruthless global dictatorship, igniting war against Batman's resistance.

title: Harley Quinn: Wild at Heart
creators: Amanda Conner, Jimmy Palmiotti, Chad Hardin
description: Harley leaves the Joker and Gotham behind to start fresh in Coney Island, managing an apartment building, roller derby bouts, and assassin bounties.

title: Justice League: Origin
creators: Geoff Johns, Jim Lee, Scott Williams
description: At the dawn of the superhero age, Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, Green Lantern, The Flash, Aquaman, and Cyborg unite for the first time to repel Darkseid's invasion.

title: Wonder Woman: Blood and Guts
creators: Brian Azzarello, Cliff Chiang
description: Zeus disappears and the Olympian gods turn on one another in a bloodthirsty civil war, dragging Diana into dark divine family intrigue.

title: Batman: The Court of Owls Saga
creators: Scott Snyder, Greg Capullo, Jonathan Glapion
description: Batman uncovers a centuries-old secret cabal ruling Gotham from the shadows with undead assassins known as Talons.

title: American Vampire: Book One
creators: Scott Snyder, Stephen King, Rafael Albuquerque
description: Traces the evolution of an American vampire species fueled by sunlight and rattlesnake venom, featuring Skinner Sweet and Pearl Jones across American history.

title: The Flash: Rebirth
creators: Geoff Johns, Ethan Van Sciver
description: Barry Allen returns from the Speed Force, but his resurrection unleashes a sinister corrupting frequency engineered by Professor Zoom.

title: Batwoman: Elegy
creators: Greg Rucka, J.H. Williams III
description: Kate Kane battles the Religion of Crime led by the crazed Alice, paired with gorgeous panel architecture and origin revelations.

title: Harley Quinn & The Gotham City Sirens
creators: Paul Dini, Guillem March
description: Catwoman, Poison Ivy, and Harley Quinn move in together to protect each other and run Gotham their own chaotic way.

title: Superman: Brainiac
collectedIssues: Action Comics #866–870, Superman: New Krypton Special #1
creators: Geoff Johns, Gary Frank, Jon Sibal
description: Superman faces the true, terrifying extraterrestrial cyborg Brainiac who bottled the Kryptonian city of Kandor.

title: Joker
creators: Brian Azzarello, Lee Bermejo, Mick Gray
description: Told through the perspective of henchman Jonny Frost, this gritty noir follows the Joker as he reclaims Gotham's criminal underworld fresh out of Arkham.

title: Green Arrow: Year One
creators: Andy Diggle, Jock
description: Billionaire playboy Oliver Queen is betrayed and stranded on a deserted island, forcing him to master archery to survive and liberate its captive workers.

title: Batman and Son
creators: Grant Morrison, Andy Kubert, Jesse Delperdang
description: Talia al Ghul introduces Bruce Wayne to the lethal son he never knew he fathered: Damian Wayne, a lethal prodigy raised by the League of Assassins.

title: Batman: Under the Red Hood
creators: Judd Winick, Doug Mahnke, Paul Lee
description: A mysterious vigilante named the Red Hood assumes command of Gotham's drug trade, revealing a haunting connection to Batman's greatest failure: Jason Todd.

title: All-Star Superman
creators: Grant Morrison, Frank Quitely, Jamie Grant
description: Dying of solar cellular decay, the Man of Steel sets out to accomplish twelve heroic labours to secure Earth's future before his time runs out.

title: Superman: Secret Identity
creators: Kurt Busiek, Stuart Immonen
description: In a real world where Superman is just a comic book character, a Kansas boy named Clark Kent suddenly discovers he actually possesses the Man of Steel's powers.

title: Catwoman: When in Rome
creators: Jeph Loeb, Tim Sale
description: Selina Kyle and the Riddler journey to Italy to unlock the secret of her mobster parentage during the events of The Long Halloween and Dark Victory.

title: Batman: Harley and Ivy
collectedIssues: Batman: Harley and Ivy #1–3, Harley and Ivy: Love on the Lam
creators: Paul Dini, Bruce Timm
description: Classic animated adventures with Gotham's favorite dynamic duo of villainy pulling off hilarious capers across Gotham and Hollywood.

title: Green Lantern: Rebirth
creators: Geoff Johns, Ethan Van Sciver
description: Hal Jordan returns to the mantle of Green Lantern as the fear entity Parallax is exposed, revitalizing the Green Lantern mythos for a generation.

title: We3
creators: Grant Morrison, Frank Quitely
description: Three weaponized cybernetic household pets—a dog, cat, and rabbit—escape a clandestine military lab in search of 'home'.

title: DC: The New Frontier
creators: Darwyn Cooke, Dave Stewart
description: Darwyn Cooke's masterwork bridges the Golden and Silver Ages through the lens of Cold War paranoia, aviation, civil rights, and cosmic wonder.

title: Batgirl: Year One
creators: Scott Beatty, Chuck Dixon, Marcos Martin, Alvaro Lopez
description: Barbara Gordon strives to become a hero despite the protective objections of her father, Commissioner James Gordon, and the Dark Knight himself.

title: Superman: Red Son
creators: Mark Millar, Dave Johnson, Kilian Plunkett
description: What if baby Kal-El's rocket ship had landed in the Soviet Union instead of Kansas? Superman becomes the champion of the common worker and Soviet state leader.

title: Superman/Batman: Book One
creators: Jeph Loeb, Ed McGuinness, Michael Turner
description: President Lex Luthor places a billion-dollar bounty on the World's Finest, followed by the dramatic arrival of Supergirl on Earth.

title: Superman: Birthright
creators: Mark Waid, Leinil Francis Yu, Gerry Alanguilan
description: A 21st-century origin story tracking Clark Kent's travels as an international photojournalist to his debut in Metropolis fighting Lex Luthor's false-flag invasion.

title: Gotham Central: In the Line of Duty
creators: Ed Brubaker, Greg Rucka, Michael Lark
description: Ground-level detectives of the Gotham City Police Department work the Major Crimes Unit, dealing with rogue supervillains without Batman's superpowers.

title: Y: The Last Man: Book One
creators: Brian K. Vaughan, Pia Guerra, José Marzán Jr.
description: A plague spontaneously wipes out every living mammal with a Y chromosome, except for an amateur escape artist named Yorick Brown and his pet monkey Ampersand.

title: Batman: Hush
creators: Jeph Loeb, Jim Lee, Scott Williams
description: A mysterious stalker with bandaged face manipulates Batman's entire rogue gallery in a calculated psychological campaign to ruin his life.

title: Superboy's Legion
creators: Mark Farmer, Alan Davis
description: In an alternate 31st Century Elseworlds, Kal-El's capsule is recovered in the 30th Century, inspiring him to form the Legion of Super-Heroes.

title: Catwoman: Trail of the Catwoman
creators: Ed Brubaker, Darwyn Cooke, Mike Allred
description: Slam Bradley investigates Selina Kyle's faked death, leading to her iconic leather catsuit redesign and defender-of-the-East-End reinvention.

title: JLA: Tower of Babel
collectedIssues: JLA #43–46, JLA Secret Files and Origins #3
creators: Mark Waid, Howard Porter, Steve Scott
description: Ra's al Ghul steals Batman's secret tactical contingency plans designed to neutralize every member of the Justice League if they went rogue.

title: 100 Bullets: First Shot, Last Call
creators: Brian Azzarello, Eduardo Risso
description: Agent Graves approaches wronged people with an attaché case containing an untraceable gun, 100 untraceable bullets, and irrefutable proof of who ruined their lives.

title: The Authority: Book One
creators: Warren Ellis, Bryan Hitch, Paul Neary
description: The definitive widescreen superhero epic following Jenny Sparks, Midnighter, Apollo, and team enforcing planetary order against cosmic threats.

title: Superman Adventures: The Man of Tomorrow
creators: Paul Dini, Rick Burchett, Terry Austin
description: Classic all-ages adventures set in the timeless DC Animated Universe (Superman: The Animated Series).

title: Batman: The Long Halloween
creators: Jeph Loeb, Tim Sale
description: Over the course of a full year, Batman, Jim Gordon, and Harvey Dent hunt a serial killer named Holiday who only executes targets on holiday dates.

title: Kingdom Come
creators: Mark Waid, Alex Ross
description: In a future where reckless new vigilantes cause catastrophic casualties, Superman steps out of exile to rebuild the old guard in this painted masterpiece.

title: Preacher: Gone to Texas
creators: Garth Ennis, Steve Dillon
description: Texas preacher Jesse Custer is bonded with a divine runaway entity giving him the Word of God, embarking across America to literally find the Almighty.

title: The Batman Adventures: The Dark Knight
creators: Kelley Puckett, Mike Parobeck, Rick Burchett
description: Pure Batman: The Animated Series comic magic, featuring the Joker, Catwoman, Penguin, and the timeless Bruce Timm art style.

title: John Constantine, Hellblazer: Dangerous Habits
creators: Garth Ennis, Will Simpson, Mark Pennington
description: Dying of terminal lung cancer, street occultist John Constantine pulls off his greatest, most brazen con against the Three Lords of Hell.

title: Batman: Gotham by Gaslight
collectedIssues: Gotham by Gaslight, Master of the Future
creators: Brian Augustyn, Mike Mignola, Eduardo Barreto
description: DC's very first Elseworlds tale pits an 1889 Victorian Batman against Jack the Ripper after the notorious killer arrives in Gotham City.

title: Batman: Arkham Asylum – A Serious House on Serious Earth
creators: Grant Morrison, Dave McKean
description: Inmates seize control of Arkham Asylum on April Fools' Day, demanding Batman enter alone to face his deepest psychological horrors and Dave McKean's surrealist art.

title: Superman: The Man of Steel
creators: John Byrne, Dick Giordano
description: John Byrne's landmark Post-Crisis reinvention of Superman, establishing the modern foundation of Krypton, Clark Kent's humanity, and corporate Lex Luthor.

title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns
creators: Frank Miller, Klaus Janson, Lynn Varley
description: A 55-year-old Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement in a crumbling, crime-ridden Gotham, battling the Mutants, the Joker, and ultimately the government's pawn: Superman.

title: Watchmen
creators: Alan Moore, Dave Gibbons, John Higgins
description: The murder of the Comedian unravels a wide-ranging conspiracy at the height of the Cold War, deconstructing the very concept of superheroes.

title: Crisis on Infinite Earths
creators: Marv Wolfman, George Pérez, Dick Giordano
description: The Anti-Monitor sweeps across the multiverse consuming parallel Earths in antimatter, forcing heroes and villains from every reality to make the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Swamp Thing: The Anatomy Lesson
collectedIssues: The Saga of the Swamp Thing #20–27
creators: Alan Moore, Stephen R. Bissette, John Totleben
description: Alan Moore shatters Alec Holland's identity: he was never a human turned into a monster, but a sentient plant that believed it was a man. An immortal gothic horror revolution.

title: V for Vendetta
creators: Alan Moore, David Lloyd
description: In a totalitarian post-nuclear Britain ruled by the fascist Norsefire regime, a masked anarchist named V wages an intricate theatrical campaign of revolution.
